A type of fine well known '''brandy''' was produced on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. Instead of quenching an individual's thirst, one sip of the beverage would make someone want more, which was compared to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator's]] [[Bevera Dodonna]] taste for power.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The brandy was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
